field_text_formatted.value: Drupal's own Preview renders the node in Drupal's theme, not your frontend, so editors save a draft to check it. Next.js draft mode smooths that workaround, but still needs a saved revision. Consumer Node Preview works on what's still in the edit form, for the person writing it, before anything is saved.
